description: CurupiraCode inside VS Code: chat with the local CurupiraCode agent about the open project, including Gemini 4 Argon through the Antigravity CLI.
command.openFullInterface: Open the full interface in the browser
config.installPath: Folder of the built CurupiraCode checkout (`pnpm install && pnpm run build`). Empty: the open folder when it is the checkout, otherwise `~/curupiracode`.
config.nodePath: Node.js executable that runs CurupiraCode. Empty: the `node` of your login shell.
config.webUrl: Address of the full CurupiraCode interface started with `pnpm curupiracode web`.
